text:
Alice M: okay team — finalizing the run-of-show and speaker slotting for the May webinar. need to lock rehearsal windows that work across NA/EU/APAC. :calendar:
Devon: +1. we should avoid >2am local for anyone. can we do two rehearsals per speaker? one for tech check, one for dry run.
Samir: suggest early EU / late NA rehearsal blocks so we overlap with APAC recording window. example: 07:00 PT / 15:00 BST / 22:00 SGT.
Priya K: that works for speakers in UK/India/SEA. but for West Coast folks 07:00 PT is rough. can we offer an alternate 10:30 PT / 18:30 BST slot?
Zoe: we have 4 external speakers + 2 internal demos. external availabilities: 
- Anjali (Bangalore): prefers 21:00 SGT or earlier
- Marco (Berlin): best midday BST
- Carla (SF): mornings PT only
- Ken (London): flexible
Devon: OK so we need 3 rehearsal blocks to cover constraints. propose: 
```
Block A - Tech check (brief) - 07:00 PT / 15:00 BST / 22:00 SGT (30m)
Block B - Dry run (full) - 10:30 PT / 18:30 BST / 01:30 SGT (60m)
Block C - Recording window (for APAC-friendly) - 23:00 PT / 07:00 BST / 14:00 SGT (60m)
```
Alice M: thanks. can we map speakers to blocks now? Carla -> Block A or B (pref morning PT). Anjali -> Block C. Marco -> Block B. Ken -> either. internal demos in Block B for full flow.
Samir: mapped in tracker, updated spreadsheet and added notes on demo fallback (if dedicated infra flaps, use pre-recorded clip). link: https://tiny.redwood/rehearsal-tracker
Priya K: routing for inbound leads from registrants — ops question: what happens when registrant selects "book a demo" checkbox? who gets pinged?
Zoe: current flow: registrant -> HubSpot form -> marketing@example.com notification -> assigns to SDR queue. We can add tag with webinar-session and interest bucket (cost/perf/secure).
Alice M: let's add a lightweight triage script so SDRs can route hot leads to solutions. Draft: "If registrant selects 'dedicated/private', mark as 1:high and notify solutions@redwood."
Devon: also want a micro-case in the deck for the benchmarks segment — 3 bullets: workload, cost delta, latency SLOs. Samir can you draft numbers?
Samir: will pull recent perf runs and send a short blurb. target is a 45-second micro-case.
marketing-bot: reminder — rehearsal invite for Block A sent to Anjali, Carla, Marco, Ken, internal-demos@redwood at 3301234600.
calendar-bot: event created: "Webinar Tech Check - Block A" 2026-05-14T07:00:00-07:00.
Priya K: one more ops note — produce an alternative run-of-show PDF for attendees in EMEA/APAC times. small ask for design: swap timestamps, highlight recordings available on-demand.
Zoe: can design make a 1-pager and localized CTA? yes, will coordinate.
Alice M: action items: Samir (micro-case text + numbers) by EOD 3301234580, Zoe (design assets + localized 1-pager) by 3301234590, Devon (final run-of-show + routing spec) by 3301234599. I'll consolidate and send final invites. :headphones:
Devon: noted. if anyone can't make assigned block, DM me and we'll re-slot. :thumbsup:
Samir: sent initial micro-case draft in thread (will keep short).
Zoe: starting design now, pulling branding kit.
Alice M: great — closing thread for now, will reopen if any conflicts. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
